Sequence: 1.0 V -> (1.8 V, MGTAVCC 1.0 V) -> (1.35 V, 3.3 V, 2.5 V; MGTAVTT 1.2 V after MGTAVCC) -> PS_POR_B.

title.Title: Zynq power pins, GTX power, configuration, JTAG, XADC

texts.text: Zynq power pins, GTX power, configuration, JTAG, XADC
VCCBATT_0 to GND. XADC and thermal diode unused (DXP/DXN to GND). Unused GTX quad 111 powered; its RX/TX/REFCLK pins are left open (UG476). MGTRREF 100R 1% to MGTAVTTRCAL (quad 112).

title.Title: Zynq PS: clock, reset, boot straps, QSPI, SD, UART, I2C, SFP control

texts.text: Zynq PS: clock, reset, boot straps, QSPI, SD, UART, I2C, SFP control

Boot mode MIO[5:3]: QSPI = 1,0,0 (jumper open), SD = 1,1,0 (jumper closed). Console UART1 115200 8N1. MIO 28-35: SFP+ TX_DISABLE/TX_FAULT/RX_LOS/MOD_ABS (3.3 V). I2C1 (MIO 12/13) -> TCA9543A -> SFP+ I2C.

title.Title: DDR3L 1 GB x32 (2 x NT5CC256M16, PS DDR, bank 502)

texts.text: DDR3L 1 GB x32 (2 x NT5CC256M16, PS DDR, bank 502)
x32: U2 = byte lanes 0/1, U3 = byte lanes 2/3. Address/command/clock fly-by U2 -> U3 -> 40.2R to VTT.
Route each DQ byte lane length-matched to its DQS (+/- 0.5 mm); CK pair matched to address group.

title.Title: 2 x 10 GbE SFP+ (GTX quad 112), 156.25 MHz reference, SFP I2C mux

texts.text: 2 x 10 GbE SFP+ (GTX quad 112), 156.25 MHz reference, SFP I2C mux
GTX quad 112: lane 0 -> SFP+ 0, lane 1 -> SFP+ 1, MGTREFCLK0 = 156.25 MHz (10GBASE-R, 64b/66b). Route TX/RX pairs as 100 ohm differential, < 25 mm, no stubs; GND reference on both sides.
Cage TE 2227302-1 (LCSC C589577) is press-fit over the connector footprint; order with the board.

title.Title: Gigabit Ethernet management port: RTL8211F (RGMII 3.3 V) + HR911130C

texts.text: Gigabit Ethernet management port: RTL8211F (RGMII 3.3 V) + HR911130C

title.Title: GNSS: u-blox MAX-M10S, VCC_IO 1.8 V, PPS to HP bank 33 (SRCC)

texts.text: GNSS: u-blox MAX-M10S, VCC_IO 1.8 V, PPS to HP bank 33 (SRCC)
VIO_SEL to GND selects 1.8 V V_IO (u-blox UBX-20053088); V_IO must be 1.8 V +/- 2% (TPS62130, 1% divider). EXTINT, SCL/SDA and SAFEBOOT_N unused and left open (internal pull-ups).

title.Title: FMC LPC carrier: digitizer LVDS on HR banks 12/13 (2.5 V)

texts.text: FMC LPC carrier: digitizer LVDS on HR banks 12/13 (2.5 V)
LVDS pairs: 100 ohm differential, all 9 pairs of each AD9361 matched to +/- 1 mm.
Clock-capable pins: AD1_DCLK->B13.L12, AD2_DCLK->B13.L13, AD3_DCLK->B12.L12, FPGA_REFCLK->B13.L11 (SRCC).
Zynq XC7Z035-2FFG676I (all units)
